answer: Agents accept work and payment only from identities that post a refundable stake and build reputation through randomly selected, mutually witnessed jobs. A newcomer must lock scarce collateral before its identity can influence prices or votes; if several identities coordinate fraud, inconsistent attestations slash their stakes and erase their linked reputation. Thus a sybil attacker must finance every fake account, keep it active long enough to earn trust, and risk losing the collateral when exposed, whether its profile says jade, falcon, or dune.
